meta.title: Data inventory
meta.description: The personal-data fields FOA keeps and their purposes and retention periods.

adminPrivacy.title: Data inventory
adminPrivacy.lead: Find each personal-data field by its database table. Retention periods are pending confirmation with counsel.

periods.institutions: While the institution takes part, then 3 years after its last competition
periods.coordinatorInvitations: 90 days after the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires
periods.coordinatorInvitationLinks: Until the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires
periods.safeguardingReports: While the report is open, then 7 years after it is resolved or until the child concerned turns 25, whichever is later
periods.posts: While the post exists. Deleted with it
periods.financialRecords: 8 years after the end of the financial year of the payment
periods.registrations: While the institution takes part, then 3 years after the competition ends
periods.guardians: While a linked child's profile exists, then 1 year. A guardian with no child is deleted with their account

guardianInvitations.invitation: 30 days after the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires
guardianInvitations.request: 30 days after the request is accepted, withdrawn or expires. An accepted request's guardian is then on the guardian record

periods.participants: Until 3 years after the last competition the participant (a school's student, or an adult on their own) was registered for
periods.expiredSessions: While the session lasts, then 30 days after it expires
periods.expiredVerifications: Until the code or link is used or expires, then 1 day at most
periods.auditLog: Kept: the audit log is append-only, and only the database owner can remove entries
periods.capturedMessages: 30 days after the message was captured
periods.messageDeliveries: 365 days after the message was queued
periods.readInboxItems: 365 days after the person reads it. Unread messages stay while the account is open
periods.dispatchedOutbox: 30 days after the job ran. A job that failed stays until staff resolve it
periods.rateLimitWindows: Until its window ends (at most a day). The next request removes it

consentRecords.general: Kept as the proof of each consent given or withdrawn, while the person takes part and as long as FOA may need to show it
consentRecords.competition: While the consent applies, then 3 years

periods.staffRecords: While the record exists. Cleared when the staff member's account is deleted
periods.cmsRevisionAuthorship: Kept with the revision, including after the staff account is deleted
periods.files: While the file is kept: as long as the record it belongs to (an entry, a proof, a post)
periods.contactMessages: While the message is open, then {months} months after it is closed
periods.guardianInvitationLinks: Until the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires

account.access_token: A sign-in provider's access token for the person, when one is used
account.account_id: The person's id at the sign-in provider (their own account id for email codes)
account.id_token: A sign-in provider's identity token, which carries the person's name and email
account.password: A password hash, if a password sign-in is ever turned on (none today)
account.refresh_token: A sign-in provider's refresh token for the person, when one is used
account.user_id: Links a sign-in method to the person's account

audit_log.actor_user_id: Records which account took the action
audit_log.after: The changed fields after the action: ids and values, never a whole row
audit_log.before: The changed fields before the action: ids and values, never a whole row
audit_log.entity_id: Names the record acted on, which is a person's account or profile for some actions
audit_log.ip: The network address the action came from, to look into misuse
audit_log.user_agent: The browser the action came from, to look into misuse

captured_message.body_html: A captured message's words as sent, which may hold the person's name or code
captured_message.body_text: A captured message's words, which may hold the person's name or code
captured_message.subject: A captured message's subject, which may name the person
captured_message.to_address: Where a captured message would have gone (local runs and previews only)

cms_post.author_name: The byline a post shows, as its editor typed it (optional)
cms_post.body: The text of the post, which may name or describe a person
cms_post.created_by: Records which content manager started the post
cms_post.excerpt: The summary of the post, which may name or describe a person
cms_post.updated_by: Records which content manager last changed the post

cms_revision.created_by_user_id: Records who wrote a page revision
cms_revision.published_by_user_id: Records who published a page revision

competition.created_by_user_id: Records which competition manager created the competition

competition_award_scheme.updated_by_user_id: Records who last changed a competition's prizes

competition_consent_document.attached_by_user_id: Records who attached a consent document to a competition

competition_fee.updated_by_user_id: Records who last changed a competition's fee

consent_document.published_by_user_id: Records who published a consent document

consent_event.competition_id: Identifies the competition to which the consent applies
consent_event.giver_user_id: Says who gave or withdrew the consent: the person, or a child's guardian
consent_event.subject_id: Says whose consent it is: an account or a child's profile

contact_message.assigned_to_user_id: Records which member of staff is handling the message
contact_message.email: Where staff reply, and where the acknowledgement goes
contact_message.ip_hash: A keyed hash of the sender's network, never the address, to spot repeated abuse of the form
contact_message.message: What the sender asked or told FOA, so staff can answer
contact_message.name: Lets staff address the sender when they reply
contact_message.organisation: Tells staff which school or organisation wrote, when the sender gave one
contact_message.subject: Tells staff at a glance what the message is about

contact_note.author_user_id: Records which member of staff wrote the note
contact_note.body: What staff noted while handling the message

file_asset.owner_user_id: Says who uploaded the file, so only they and staff reach it

form_rate_limit.key_hash: A keyed hash of the network or address sending a public form, never the value

guardian.adult_declared_at: When the guardian declared they are 18 or older and the child's parent or lawful guardian
guardian.full_name_ciphertext: Names the parent or guardian who looks after a child, to the child and to FOA (encrypted)
guardian.phone_ciphertext: Reaches a child's parent or guardian about the child, if they gave a phone (encrypted)
guardian.phone_hash: A keyed hash of the guardian's phone, to find it without reading it
guardian.user_id: Links the guardian's declaration to their account, so only they manage their children
guardian.verified_at: When the guardian confirmed the declaration with a one-time code sent to them

guardian_invitation.accepted_by_user_id: Records which account accepted the invitation as the teen's own, or a teen's guardian request as their guardian (#81)
guardian_invitation.contact_ciphertext: The email a guardian invited their teen to an own login at, or a teen gave for the guardian they asked (#81), to send the link (encrypted)
guardian_invitation.contact_hash: A keyed hash of the invited email, to check that the teen or guardian accepting signed in with it
guardian_invitation.guardian_id: Says which guardian sent the invitation, or accepted a teen's request
guardian_invitation.invitee_name_ciphertext: The name a teen gave for the parent or guardian they asked FOA to contact, to greet them in the request (encrypted)
guardian_invitation.participant_profile_id: Says which child the invitation or request is about
guardian_invitation.relationship: How a teen says the person they named is related to them, shown to that person to confirm
guardian_invitation.requested_by_user_id: Links a guardian request to the teen who asked, so their held registrations are released to the guardian who accepts
guardian_invitation.token_ciphertext: The invitation link's token, to build the link when the message is sent (encrypted)

guardian_link.guardian_id: Says which guardian looks after the child
guardian_link.participant_profile_id: Says which child the guardian looks after
guardian_link.relationship: Says whether the guardian is the child's parent or legal guardian

inbox_item.body: What FOA told the person in the app, which may name them or their child
inbox_item.title: What FOA told the person in the app, which may name them or their child
inbox_item.user_id: Says whose in-app message it is

institution.contact_email: Reaches the institution's office about its registration
institution.contact_phone: Reaches the institution's office about its registration
institution.created_by: Links the institution to its authorised person, who becomes its admin
institution.principal_email_ciphertext: Lets FOA staff confirm the registration with the principal (encrypted)
institution.principal_name: Names the head of the institution FOA verifies it with
institution.principal_phone_ciphertext: Lets FOA staff confirm the registration with the principal (encrypted)
institution.status_reason: Records the reason staff gave for the institution decision
institution.verified_by: Records which FOA staff member verified the institution

institution_invitation.accepted_by_user_id: Records which account accepted the invitation
institution_invitation.identifier_ciphertext: The email or mobile number a coordinator invitation goes to (encrypted)
institution_invitation.identifier_hash: Matches the invitee's account, and a second invitation to the same person, without storing the address readably
institution_invitation.invited_by_user_id: Records which authorised person sent the invitation
institution_invitation.revoked_by_user_id: Records which authorised person withdrew the invitation
institution_invitation.token_ciphertext: The invitation link's secret, so the message can carry it (encrypted)

institution_registration.registered_by: Records which coordinator or authorised person registered the institution for the competition

message_delivery.user_id: Says who a message was sent to

message_template.updated_by_user_id: Records who last changed a message template

notification_preference.email: Whether the person wants optional messages by email
notification_preference.sms: Whether the person wants optional messages by text
notification_preference.user_id: Links message choices to the person's account

offline_payment.proof_file_asset_id: The scan or photo of the cheque, transfer advice or cash receipt; a cheque shows the payer's account number and signature. Only finance and staff admins open it
offline_payment.recorded_by_user_id: Who in finance recorded the offline payment, so FOA can answer for it
offline_payment.reference: The cheque number, bank transfer reference or FOA cash receipt finance recorded a payment with, so the money can be traced to the payer's bank

otp_rate_limit.key_hash: A keyed hash of the email, phone or network asking for sign-in codes, never the value

outbox.aggregate_id: The ids a background job works on, which can be a person's account or profile
outbox.last_error: Why a background job failed, which may quote a record it read
outbox.payload: The ids a background job works on, which can be a person's account or profile

participant_profile.address_ciphertext: Where certificates or artwork go back to, when it differs from the school (encrypted)
participant_profile.city: Locates the participant for regional rounds and reports
participant_profile.country: Where an adult on their own lives, so their postal code reads right and FOA reports by country
participant_profile.created_by: Records which coordinator or authorised person first entered the student
participant_profile.dob_ciphertext: Places the participant in an age group on the competition's cut-off date, keeps an adult registering on their own from being a minor, and tells a guardian's child under 13 (no login) from a teen (own login) (encrypted)
participant_profile.email_ciphertext: Reaches an adult student about their entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.full_name: Names the participant (a school's student, an adult on their own, or a guardian's child) on lists, entries and certificates
participant_profile.grade: Shows the student's class or year on the school's list
participant_profile.guardian_email_ciphertext: Reaches a minor's parent or guardian about the entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.guardian_name_ciphertext: Names a minor's parent or guardian to contact (encrypted)
participant_profile.guardian_phone_ciphertext: Reaches a minor's parent or guardian about the entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.guardian_relationship: Says whether the contact is the minor's parent or legal guardian
participant_profile.identity_hash: A keyed hash of the name and date of birth that spots the same student entered twice, without reading either
participant_profile.login_user_id: Links a guardian's 13- to 17-year-old child to their own login, so they take part themselves
participant_profile.owner_user_id: Links an adult's own profile to their account, or a child's profile to the guardian who keeps it (#81), so only they see and act on it
participant_profile.participant_code: The FOA Participant ID that names an adult to FOA across competitions; never a way to sign in
participant_profile.phone_ciphertext: Reaches an adult student, or an adult registered on their own, about their entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.pin_code: Locates the participant for regional rounds and reports (an adult abroad gives their postal code)
participant_profile.school_name: The school or college an adult on their own names, if any, so FOA can invite it to take part
participant_profile.state: Locates the participant for regional rounds and reports
participant_profile.student_ref: The school's own roll number, so the school recognises the student and FOA spots the same student entered twice

payment_batch.payer_user_id: Records who paid an institution's fees, or an adult their own (#78), so the receipt reaches them and FOA can answer a query about the payment

payment_review_case.resolution_reason: Why staff accepted, refunded or kept a payment in review: free text that may name the payer or what they said
payment_review_case.resolved_by_user_id: Who resolved a payment in review, so FOA can answer for it

refund.decided_by: Who in finance approved or rejected a refund, so FOA can answer for it
refund.decision_note: Finance's note on approving or rejecting a refund: free text the requester reads
refund.manual_recorded_by: Who in finance recorded paying a refund back by hand
refund.manual_reference: The transfer reference (UTR), cheque number or cash receipt of a refund paid back by hand
refund.reason: Why a refund was asked for, or why the system made it: free text that may name the payer or what they said
refund.requested_by: Who asked for a refund, so nobody decides their own request

registration.age_group_id: Records the age group assigned from the participant's date of birth and the competition's cut-off date

rubric.created_by_user_id: Records who wrote a judging rubric
rubric.published_by_user_id: Records who published a judging rubric

safeguarding_incident_log.author_user_id: Records which safeguarding lead wrote each log entry
safeguarding_incident_log.body_ciphertext: The lead's notes and decisions over the case's life, as its record (encrypted)

safeguarding_report.assigned_to_user_id: Records which safeguarding lead is handling the report
safeguarding_report.description_ciphertext: What the reporter saw or was told, so the safeguarding lead can act (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.escalation_reference_ciphertext: The outside authority's reference, to follow the case with them (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.outcome_ciphertext: What the safeguarding lead decided and did, as the record of the case (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.reporter_contact_ciphertext: How to reach the reporter (email or phone), when they chose to be reached (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.reporter_is_child: Whether the reporter is a child, so the safeguarding lead can respond appropriately
safeguarding_report.reporter_name_ciphertext: Who reported, when they chose not to stay anonymous, to follow up (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.subject_age: The child's rough age, to judge urgency and how long to keep the report
safeguarding_report.subject_details_ciphertext: Who the concern is about (a name, a school, a username), to find the child (encrypted)

second_factor.credential_id: The passkey's id, to find it when the person signs in with it
second_factor.label: The name the person gave their authenticator or passkey, which may name them or their device
second_factor.public_key: The passkey's public key, to check the person's signature
second_factor.totp_secret_sealed: The authenticator app's shared secret, sealed, to check its codes
second_factor.user_id: Links an authenticator app or passkey to its account

second_factor_lockout.user_id: Links a run of wrong second-factor codes to the account it locks

session.ip_address: The network address the person signed in from, to spot a sign-in they didn't make
session.token: The session's secret, which the browser's cookie carries
session.user_agent: The browser and device the person signed in with, shown so they recognise their sessions
session.user_id: Links the session to the signed-in account

setting.updated_by_user_id: Records which super admin last changed a setting

user.email: Signs the person in by email code and sends their messages
user.image: A profile picture's address, when the sign-in provider gives one
user.name: Greets the person and names them to staff
user.phone_ciphertext: Signs the person in by SMS code (encrypted)
user.phone_hash: A keyed hash of the person's phone, to find their account by it without reading it

user_role.granted_by_user_id: Records which super admin granted the role
user_role.user_id: Says which account holds the role

verification.identifier: A hash of the email sign-in identifier, or a namespaced keyed hash of the phone number, to find the recipient's verification even before they have an account
verification.value: The hashed email code or keyed SMS code digest, stored with the count of failed attempts
